## Accessibility

<!-- Only for changes to the interface. Otherwise write "Not an interface change". -->

- [ ] `npm run a11y` passes: no new axe problem, and the keyboard walk passes.
- [ ] Gone through with the keyboard only: focus is visible, every control is reachable, focus does not get stuck.
- [ ] New or changed controls have names a screen reader can read.
- [ ] Colour is not the only way something is shown, and the text contrast is enough.
- [ ] New interface text goes through `src/core/i18n.ts`, in Slovak and English.
- [ ] Any problem I found and did not fix has an issue with the `accessibility` label, linked here.
